projects.title: River-Level Forecasting Capstone
bullets: Aligned public river-level measurement time series as a contribution to a supervised undergraduate team capstone on environmental forecasting.
Implemented a seasonal baseline for forecasting public environmental time series using Python, pandas and scikit-learn.

research.title: Temperature Sensor Forecasting Assistance
bullets: Identified missing observations and aligned public temperature sensor time series as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Used Python, pandas and scikit-learn in assigned environmental time-series forecasting work, including plotting forecast residuals.
